{{Top|leg}}
A '''power fusion generator''' was a mobile power source. The [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] used power fusion generators to power large assault weapons because of their light weight and efficiency.

The [[EG-6 power droid/Legends|EG-6 power droid]] was essentially a walking fusion generator.

Readily available throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], the generators were available in light, medium, and heavy varieties. Light generators sold for five hundred [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], medium for seven hundred and fifty credits, and a thousand credits for a heavy generator.<ref name="SWS">''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]''</ref>
